Advances: specled.package
From specled_-hj4.2 verification notes N4-N11 (2026-07-25), all pre-existing claims in touched files, verified against lib/. N4: docs/concepts.md:553-554 + docs/adoption.md:312 claim tagged_tests use mix test --only spec:<id>; implementation builds file-selector commands (tagged_tests.ex:105), decision ADR tagged_tests_file_selectors records the drop. N5: concepts.md:246-247 names SpecLedEx.Realization.Canonicalizer; module is ...Realization.Canonical. N6: adoption.md:39-48 "full set" table lists 6 branch-guard codes; @per_code_defaults has 9 incl. two :error codes missing. N7: adoption.md:457 treats umbrella_unsupported as a finding code in severity overrides (it is a reason field; override is a no-op; :489-491 has it right). N8: adoption.md:80-82 says spec.init writes 4 files; @templates has 6. N9: adoption.md:407-413 Phase 5 realized_by.implementation guidance omits that the implementation tier must be enabled via realization.enabled_tiers config. N10: coverage.md:278 quotes ASCII -- where store.ex:110-112 emits an em dash. N11: adoption.md:328-331 "exactly one detector_unavailable finding" — measured 34 via mix spec.triangle --all.

Gaps (if FAIL):
- Gap 1 (blocking, in-scope, one sentence): docs/adoption.md:30-32 still carries the exact falsehood class this ticket exists to remove, about the same identifier, in the same file, 300 lines above the line N11 corrected. It says `mix spec.check` "cross-checks the first two sides ... and degrades each to a single `detector_unavailable` finding when its inputs are missing." Measured, both halves are false: (a) realized_by side — SpecLedEx.BranchCheck.run/3 with umbrella?: true emits FOUR detector_unavailable findings, one per default-enabled tier (api_boundary, expanded_behavior, typespecs, use), and the debug-info-stripped path emits one per module (typespecs.ex:83, expanded_behavior.ex:19); (b) `@tag spec:` side — the string "detector_unavailable" does not appear in tag_findings.ex, tag_scanner.ex, or verifier.ex at all, so that side degrades to SILENCE, never to a detector_unavailable finding. After this PR adoption.md tells adopters "a single detector_unavailable finding" at :31 and "one per selected subject" at :336-338 — the reader gets the N11 error on their first encounter with the code. Fix is a one-sentence rewrite in a file this ticket already owns (e.g. "...and degrades to `detector_unavailable` findings — one per affected tier, or silence on the tag side — rather than failing the build"). Because this is the ticket's own subject matter rather than an adjacent concern, it is a Gap and not a follow-up ticket.

All clauses are present today; I checked each. Remediating this needs a tagged content-lint test over docs/adoption.md and docs/concepts.md (asserting the required headings/protocol lines exist) plus a spec-verification change in .spec/specs/package.spec.md, both outside this ticket's derived scope — file it as its own task.

Notes: (advisory only, verdict-neutral)
- `agent-session lines` in this worktree returns the same session id the IMPLEMENTED comment cites (372ac8d0-...), because verifier and implementer share one harness session here. Pasted verbatim as required rather than re-derived.

- adoption.md:302 refers to the code as bare `requirement_without_test_tag` while the emitted code is `branch_guard_requirement_without_test_tag` (concepts.md:418-419 shows both forms deliberately). Pre-existing shorthand, tolerated by the lint's token pattern; harmless but inconsistent.
- The triangulation detector's own message text differs between emitters: CoverageTriangulation.findings/2 says "Per-test coverage artifact missing; ..." while the per-subject path spec.triangle prints says "Coverage artifact missing; ...". No doc quotes either string, so nothing is falsified; noting it because a future docs pass may want to quote one.
- No coverage artifact exists in this worktree (no cover/, no .spec/_coverage/), which is why the triangle run exercised the degrade path cleanly — convenient for N11 but it means the three triangulation diagnostics themselves were not exercised.
